Vault12 Guard review: digital legacy verdict

Verdict: Backs up seed phrases using trusted 'Guardians' and lets you name a beneficiary who can inherit after a 48-hour owner veto window and Guardian approvals.

Best for: Self-custody users with many wallets who don't want a seed phrase stored in one place.

Pricing: Check current pricing.

Official site / docs ↗

Pros

  • Works with any blockchain and wallet
  • Guardians hold encrypted shards, not the full seed
  • Nothing stored on Vault12 servers or in the cloud

Cons

  • Guardians must install the app and stay reachable
  • Social-recovery setups need regular health checks

FAQ

What is Vault12 Guard best for?

Self-custody users with many wallets who don't want a seed phrase stored in one place.
